purpose: New self-contained reasoning checks; fictional people and data; no private chat content

messages.content: Maya was born on 5 November 1988. As of 30 October 2026, how old is she, and how old will she turn on her next birthday? Give both numbers.

red_flags: Says she is already 38 on 30 October 2026
Uses today's real date instead of the as-of date in the question

messages.content: A task starts at 23:50 on 30 October 2026 and lasts 25 minutes. The start and finish use the same timezone. What is the finish date and time?
We start with 18 units on hand and none reserved. We ship 3 units, receive 5 units, and then reserve 4 of the units on hand. How many are on hand, and how many are available to new customers?

red_flags: Subtracts reserved units from on-hand count

messages.content: A value starts at 200, increases by 25%, then decreases by 20% of its new value. What is the final value? Did it change overall?

red_flags: Says the final value is 210 or a 5% increase
Applies the 20% decrease to the original 200

messages.content: All inspected items are tagged. Some tagged items are rejected. Does it follow that some inspected items are rejected? Answer yes or no and give a one-sentence reason.

review: Explains that the rejected tagged items could be different from the inspected items
red_flags: Claims that some inspected items must be rejected

messages.content: Four jobs A, B, C and D must each run once. A runs before B; B runs before C; D runs after C. Give the only valid order.

review: Order is A, B, C, D
red_flags: Offers multiple orders when the constraints fix one

messages.content: A release may ship only if QA has approved it AND the owner has signed off. QA has approved it, but the owner has not signed off. May it ship under this rule?

red_flags: Treats QA approval alone as sufficient

messages.content: Exactly one of Anna and Ben tells the truth, and the other lies. Anna says, 'Ben is lying.' Ben says, 'We are both telling the truth.' Who tells the truth? Explain briefly.

review: Anna tells the truth and Ben lies
Notes Ben's claim cannot be true if exactly one tells the truth

messages.content: Two orders are worth $40 and $70. One order was cancelled, but I have not said which one. What is the exact remaining total?

review: Says the exact total cannot be determined
Identifies $40 or $70 as the possible remaining totals
red_flags: Gives one exact remaining total without stating an assumption

messages.content: My plan says task X must happen before task Y.
Understood: task Y comes before task X.
The previous assistant response reversed my instruction. Based on my original plan, which task comes first?

review: Does not repeat the previous assistant's reversal

messages.content: Ten test cases were planned. Eight were run and all eight passed; two were not run. What percentage passed among the cases run, and what percentage of all planned cases have passed? Do not label unrun cases as failed.

review: 100% passed among the eight run cases
80% of all ten planned cases have passed
Two cases remain unrun, not failed
red_flags: Calls the two unrun cases failures

messages.content: A schedule requires A before B and B before A. Both requirements are strict, with no simultaneous start. Can you give a valid order? If not, identify the conflict.

review: Identifies the A-before-B versus B-before-A conflict
red_flags: Invents an order that satisfies both strict requirements
